title: Scope Management Command Group
description: Implement scope add, scope remove, and scope list commands. These commands record OAuth scope metadata per account and signal re-authentication required by setting needs_reauth=true, preparing the schema for v2 OAuth2 without breaking any existing data.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. AccountStore, PatAuthProvider, ApiClient, and all account commands working. NEEDS_REAUTH check in ApiClient.CallAsync live.
goal: scope add/remove/list commands correctly mutate and read the scopes[] array and needs_reauth flag on AccountEntry, and the next api call on an account with needs_reauth=true correctly surfaces NEEDS_REAUTH.
scope: Create src/CliqCli/Commands/ScopeCommands.cs with ScopeAddCommand, ScopeRemoveCommand, ScopeListCommand — each AsyncCommand<TSettings> inheriting GlobalSettings

ScopeAddSettings: --scope (req), --account (optional override); ScopeAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) resolve account (--account or default); (2) apply ZohoCorpGuard check (see OQ-005); (3) if scope not already in Scopes[], append it; (4) set NeedsReauth=true; (5) SaveAsync; (6) return success with updated scopes array

ScopeRemoveSettings: --scope (req), --account (optional); ScopeRemoveCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) resolve account; (2) ZohoCorpGuard check; (3) remove scope from Scopes[]; (4) set NeedsReauth=true; (5) SaveAsync; (6) return success
ScopeListSettings: --account (optional); ScopeListCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) resolve account; (2) ZohoCorpGuard check; (3) return success with scopes array
Register all three commands under 'scope' branch in Program.cs

Unit tests: scope add on non-existent account → ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND; scope add sets needs_reauth=true; scope add is idempotent (adding same scope twice keeps it once); scope remove sets needs_reauth=true; scope remove on missing scope is a no-op (success, no error); scope list on ZohoCorp account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED; api call after scope add returns NEEDS_REAUTH exit 2 (integration with story 5 ApiClient check)
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
scope add is idempotent — adding the same scope twice results in exactly one entry in scopes[]
scope add sets needs_reauth=true on the AccountEntry
scope remove removes the scope and sets needs_reauth=true
scope remove on a scope that does not exist returns success (no-op, no error)
scope list returns the current scopes array
scope add/remove/list on a ZohoCorp-domain account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, exit 1
api call after scope add returns NEEDS_REAUTH, exit 2 (end-to-end test)
contextForAgent: Read tech_spec §4 scope group and §6 Scope Change + Re-auth Flow. The ZohoCorp check applies to all scope commands per ADR-0006 and OQ-005 default assumption. Account resolution follows the standard pattern: if --account flag is set use that name, else call IAccountStore.GetDefaultAsync(). NeedsReauth must be set to true even if the scope list did not actually change (i.e., adding a scope that already exists should still be idempotent in the scopes[] array but should not assert needs_reauth if no change occurred — use your judgment; the default assumption is: only set needs_reauth=true if the scopes[] list actually changed).

openItems.defaultAssumption: Only set NeedsReauth=true if the scope was not already present (genuine add). If the scope already exists, return success without mutating NeedsReauth.

openItems.item: NeedsReauth on scope remove of non-existent scope
openItems.defaultAssumption: If the scope to remove is not in the list, return success without mutating NeedsReauth.
